sources.name: PubChem
sources.notes: Use compound records as evidence for formula, charge, SMILES, Standard InChI/InChIKey and PubChem CID. Preserve record-level provenance. Do not copy source prose or images into canonical records.

sources.name: ChEBI
sources.notes: Prefer curated 3-star records when available. Retain CHEBI IDs and attribution when ChEBI evidence is used.

sources.name: Crystallography Open Database
sources.notes: Use for crystal-scope records and crystallographic identifiers. Preserve original article attribution even though COD data are CC0.

sources.name: IUPAC / InChI standard
sources.access: Published InChI standard and reference implementation documentation
sources.notes: Standard InChI records in this package use the InChI=1S/ prefix. InChI/InChIKey are identifiers, not substitutes for structure-scope classification.

sources.name: RDKit
sources.notes: RDKit is a deterministic processing tool, not an authority source. Persist toolkit/version for derived fields and never persist toolkit objects as canonical data.
